caption:
Drill one skill, then mix them up.

Blocks help you learn a new skill. Mixed sets train you to recognize what each question is testing, which you have to do on test day.

Comment which skill you're drilling right now.
tiktok_caption: Drill one skill, then mix them up. Learn it in a block, prove it in a mix.

youtube.title: SAT Study Tip: Blocked vs Mixed Practice
youtube.description: Learn a new SAT skill in a focused block, then move to mixed sets where you name each question's skill before solving.
